settings.heading: Proven gentle. Actually effective.
settings.intro: Baby formulas stop working by age four. Adult formulas are too harsh until well past twelve. We formulate for the nine years everyone else skips.
settings.disclaimer: *Based on a self-assessed consumer study. Individual results vary.

settings.heading: pH 5.5-balanced
settings.text: A child's acid mantle is still developing. Every formula sits at the same pH as healthy skin, so it cleans without stripping.

settings.heading: Dermatologically tested
settings.text: Every product is tested for safety on young skin, then tested again on children in the 4–12 range — not on adults and scaled down.
